about_the_game:
Step into the world of LEGO Voyagers with its warm, hand-crafted original soundtrack made by Swedish-Danish composer Henrik Lindstrand. A collection of melodic, instrumental pieces shaped with guitars, analog synths, piano, organs, strings, and a palette of instruments played and recorded in Lindstrand´s own studio. Written in close creative exchange with the game’s designers, the music carries the emotions of two tiny 1x1 LEGO bricks on their wordless journey. Some themes began life on Henrik’s old childhood Casio keyboard, its nostalgic tone sparking memories that seeped into the melodies. Others grew slowly, shaped by the game’s evolving story of friendship, growth, and change. Every track feels personal - warm, organic, and unpolished in the best way - music that invites you to lean in and listen.

Henrik Lindstrand is known for his minimalist piano trilogy Leken, Nattresan, and Nordhem, his orchestral work Klangland, and as a long-time member of Danish band Kashmir. His game score for LEGO Builder’s Journey won international acclaim. Henrik on the creative process:“Spending four years on LEGO Voyagers alongside such a passionate and creative team has been a gift. Being part of the journey from the very first sketches to the finished game made the music deeply personal to me and I’m grateful for every moment we shared bringing it to life. I truly hope players will feel the same joy and connection listening to it as I felt while creating it”.
